_doc: CRITICALITY-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-13): the north star as numbers. Criticality means the loops produce more verified deploys than they consume in cost and attention. `python3 -m foundation criticality --run --apply` measures it, stores it (ops/criticality.jsonl and the dashboard D1), files a fix item when it falls and completes or re-dispatches its own queue items. Every number here is a budget or a definition the loop may tune by PR with a prediction; none is an approval gate.

automated._why: Every run is attributed to the owner's token, so the actor says nothing. A deploy is zero-human when its origin commit was made by a bot author or merged from a pull request the executor or a manager opened, or when the event is a schedule or a Worker dispatch. A pull request from an interactive session (claude/*, any other branch) or a direct push is human-attended.

budgets._why: d1: Rowan's 150M rows a day. neurons: the 90% cost target, 80 USD a month at 0.011 USD per 1000 neurons, 242k a day. attention: three human interventions a day. deploys: the zero-human verified deploys a day that count as full output.
